questions.prompt: Why perform rough alignment before using the laser?
questions.answer: The laser tool has a limited measurement range
options: The laser tool has a limited measurement range
It eliminates the need for all measurements
questions.explanation: Rough alignment brings the shafts within the laser system's useful range.
